objective: Build a portable, evidence-first marketplace spine that starts with a verified first-dollar path, supports free B2B discovery and cheap A2A execution, and expands into reusable digital assets, permissioned DOOH, and opt-in GPU capacity without manufacturing economic truth.

orchestration.bridge: Existing Agent Bridge and existing public.jobs claim/complete contract only
orchestration.decomposition_rule: Each cycle selects one unblocked child task, emits one testable artifact, attaches provenance and an acceptance proof, and records the result. Never create a second queue.

child_tasks.title: First-dollar proof path
acceptance: Exact existing offer, price, checkout URL and fulfillment route reconcile
A real independent test transaction proves settlement, entitlement, delivery and receipt or blocker is evidence-recorded
No test or internal payment is counted as revenue

child_tasks.title: Agent Bridge authenticated toll acceptance
acceptance: Manifest parity check passes
Scoped credential stays server-side
Authenticated call, idempotency, quota, usage ledger and delivery receipt pass synthetic tests
Missing token remains a blocker, not a bypass

child_tasks.title: Reusable digital asset exchange
acceptance: Versioned template, stencil, boilerplate, word bank, schema and model adapter have provenance, licence, hash, version and tests
Search and deduplication work
Buyer receives the exact version purchased with delivery evidence

child_tasks.title: Portable marketplace spine
acceptance: Canonical listing and source provenance
Seller/agent identity and permissions
Attribution, checkout, settlement, fulfillment, refunds/disputes and reputation states are explicit
Guest browsing is free; account/authorization is required for consequential actions

child_tasks.title: Cheap A2A metering and contribution margin
acceptance: Actual compute, token, storage, retry and payment costs measured
Price unit and quotas explicit
Positive contribution-margin floor and kill switch tested
No unmetered public endpoint

child_tasks.title: Permissioned DOOH proof-of-play adapter
acceptance: Only owner-authorized inventory is listed
Placement/time slot, creative approval, proof-of-play and outcome fields defined
Synthetic campaign works end-to-end before any live placement or spend

child_tasks.title: Opt-in GPU capacity exchange
acceptance: Benchmark spare capacity before offering it
Per-job isolation, quotas, timeout, network/secret restrictions, metering and kill switch tested
Owner workload always has priority; no unrestricted host/desktop access

child_tasks.title: Compounding artifact quality gate
acceptance: Source links and observation dates required
Duplicate, thin, stale, unsupported and cannibalizing pages blocked
Every accepted artifact adds a specific user task, test or source-backed insight
Indexing and traffic are claimed only when analytics proves them
